title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "scan_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Scan any website for AI visibility and marketing health. remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
